oracle: tests/e2e/flask_oracle.py through a one-line factory wrapper (CTFd.create_app()), 2026-11-19, Flask 2.1.3 under the pin's own environment, SQLite defaults, no other service: it boots and lists 174 rules (256 method pairs): 92 rules (156 pairs) are Flask-RESTx namespaces (CTFd/api/__init__.py), which this catalog does NOT read; 2 are the framework's own (/static, /swaggerui); 80 rules (98 pairs) are core Flask registrations (source outside CTFd/api/ has 77 `.route(` calls and 2 add_url_rule calls; 79 against 80 rules, the one-off not reconciled). Sextant reads 95 of those 98 method pairs (77 of the 80 rules), re-recorded in plan 5 Task 6b after the flask catalog gained the Flask 2.1.3 owners (`flask.scaffold.Scaffold`, `flask.app.Flask`, `flask.blueprints.Blueprint`; measured by scripts/probes/flask_rules.py run in this pin's environment, quoted in flask_rules.md): this pin recorded 0 before. Every one of the 95 rows is at a (method, path) the oracle lists, and every row that names a handler names the oracle's handler function (21 do, 0 differ); the oracle lists one more pair than the distinct addresses Sextant has because `/themes/<theme>/static/<path:path>` is registered twice in CTFd/views.py (`themes`, `themes_beta`), which Sextant keeps as two rows. The 3 pairs it misses are the plugin asset routes (`/plugins/{challenges,dynamic_challenges,flags}/assets/<path:path>`): CTFd/plugins/__init__.py registers them with `app.add_url_rule(rule=rule, ...)` inside `register_plugin_assets_directory(app, base_path, ...)`, where `app` is an unannotated parameter, so the receiver's class is not known (the scanner types only what a library file or an annotation writes), and the rule is built from the `base_path` parameter. 74 of the 95 rows carry no handler (59 are `partial`): the handlers are wrapped by CTFd's own decorators (`@admins_only`, `@authed_only`, ...), which the decorator reader cannot follow to the `def`, so the address is read and the handler is not named. The 6 outbound rows are Sextant's own output, spot-checked against source (versioning.ctfd.io, mailgun).
